scenario_meta.description: A public museum exhibits debts that nations, guilds, and families have not incurred yet. Curators stabilize possible obligations, actuaries price alternate histories, thieves swap liability provenance, and visitors can make an exhibit become real. Build exactly six connected, functionally distinct galleries and twelve socially entangled agents. Make probability and debt ownership alter access, prices, relationships, room states, and future event hooks. Include one or two monumental world-specific semantic exhibits per room. Use black basalt, frosted glass, oxidized silver, signal red, pale mint illumination, and white ceramic tally forms without writing in a coherent top-down pixel-art canon. Avoid generic museums, generic sci-fi terminals, Beijing references, signs, captions, readable letters, logos, and text baked into art.

image_generation.prompt_policy: Grounded social-systems illustration with readable rooms, paperwork, tools, and no visible text or watermark.
